invention.ref: Go (weiqi) traditionally dated to ancient China in the 2nd–1st millennium BCE
invention.ref_zh: 围棋传统上追溯至中国公元前二千纪至一千纪

popularization.ref: Earliest reliable textual reference in the Zuo Zhuan (event of 548 BCE)
popularization.ref_zh: 《左传》记载公元前548年事，为目前较早可靠书证

locations.place_label_zh: 中国中原（早期围棋传统）

notes: 传说尧舜为教子而发明围棋，年代过于久远且无实证。学界普遍认为围棋起源于中国上古，但具体世纪难以敲定；目前较早的可靠文献是《左传》中涉及弈棋的记载。本条目以约公元前一千年为发明粗标，并以书证年作普及参照。
notes_en: Legends crediting Yao or Shun are unprovable. Scholars generally place weiqi’s origin in ancient China, but the exact century is unclear; an early firm textual anchor is the Zuo Zhuan. This entry uses a rough first-millennium BCE invention mark plus the textual reference year.
summary_zh: 围棋起源于中国上古，传说发明人不可考；约公元前一千年已可能存在，公元前548年《左传》提供较早书证。
summary_en: Go (weiqi) originated in ancient China; legendary inventors are unprovable. It likely existed by the first millennium BCE, with an early textual anchor in 548 BCE.
